title: Cel Anime 80s
look: Hand-painted 1980s cels: a coloured line, a hard shadow and a highlight band, on 12 fps.

doc.essence: A frame from a late-1980s anime film painted on acetate: a taller, leaner character, sharp almond eyes, every colour cut into a lit band, a base and a shadow, in front of a dusk sky.
doc.notIt: Not anime (taller, leaner, almond eyes, three tones with a highlight, 12 fps), not synthwave (painted cel, no neon).
doc.shapes: A taller egg-shaped head, longer thin limbs that taper, a coloured line darker than the body.
doc.colour: Three hard tones per area: a pale highlight crescent at the top left, the base colour and a plum-tinted shadow. Slightly warm, dusky palette.
doc.eyes: Almond eyes with a heavy upper line that sweeps past the outer corner, a thin lower line, a small iris with one slanted highlight. Long thin brows.
doc.motion: 12 fps, with a little overshoot on the arms.
pitfalls: The 12 fps step plus a slight snap can feel slow on short actions.
Long limbs reach the edge of the frame on big poses: keep limb length modest.
